keys.name: sum_weights
keys.description: Weighted slots only: the sum of the valid weights of the rows whose value was present.

keys.name: n_eff
keys.description: Weighted slots of kind probability only: Kish effective sample size (sum of weights)^2 / sum of squared weights.

keys.name: n_weight_invalid
keys.description: Weighted slots only: rows with a present value whose weight was invalid (null, negative, NaN/Inf, non-integer frequency) and was excluded.

keys.name: sum
keys.description: Running sum of non-null field values; combined with n to recover the mean (the weighted sum Σw·x on a weighted slot).

keys.name: sum_weighted
keys.description: Weighted slots only: Σw·x over the contributing rows.

keys.name: weighted_mean
keys.description: Weighted slots only: Σw·x / Σw (the scalar).

keys.name: m2_weighted
keys.description: Weighted slots only: Σw(x − mean)², the weighted second central moment.

keys.name: sum_weights_sq
keys.description: Weighted slots only: Σw², the Kish n_eff denominator.

keys.name: weighted_variance
keys.description: Weighted slots only: m2_weighted / (Σw − 1), the frequency-weights sample variance; null (NaN) when Σw ≤ 1.

warnings.message: FEAT_TARGET_ENCODE without params.fit_on averages every record's outcome, the record's own and validation/test records' included; a preceding FEAT_TRAIN_TEST_SPLIT does not change that — set params.fit_on to the training rows (e.g. "split == 0"), optionally with folds for out-of-fold training values
